description.p: VerseLatch creates synchronized LRC timing from audio, or verifies and aligns an existing LRC or text lyrics file against a recording.

Generated speech-recognition text remains an editable draft. Existing lyrics are preserved during Verify & Align. Results must be reviewed before they can be saved; analysis runs on the user's device without telemetry or a background service.
Fixes stale-source save protection, adds fail-closed per-user installation ownership checks, and adds portable repository CI.
Initial release with LRC draft generation, Verify & Align, editable review, and review-before-save safeguards.
